'''Mikhail Yemtsev''' (Russian: Михаил Тихонович Емцев, June 3, 1930 – August 25, 2003) - [[USSR|Soviet]] and Russian [[science fiction]] writer who worked mostly in collaboration with [[Yeremey Parnov]].

==Collaborative works with Yeremey Parnov==

'''Collected stories'''
* {{transliteration|ru|Uravneniye s Blednogo Neptuna}}; English translation: ''The Pale Neptune Equation''<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://sf-encyclopedia.com/entry/emtsev_mikhail|title=SFE: Emtsev, Mikhail}}</ref>
* {{transliteration|ru|Padeniye sverkhnovoy}}
* {{transliteration|ru|Posledneye puteshestviye polkovnika Fosetta}}
* {{transliteration|ru|Zelyonaya krevetka}}
* {{transliteration|ru|Tri kvarka}}
* {{transliteration|ru|Yarmarka teney}}

'''Novels'''
* {{transliteration|ru|Dusha Mira}}; English translation: ''[[World Soul (novel)|World Soul]]''<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://sf-encyclopedia.com/entry/emtsev_mikhail|title=SFE: Emtsev, Mikhail}}</ref>
* {{transliteration|ru|More Diraka}}
* {{transliteration|ru|Klochya tmy na igle vremeni}}
